lines.en: I slide sideways through the water.
One flick of my tail shoots me on.
I cut a line across the surface.
I skim along the riverbed.
I loop half around a stone.
My body jerks forward.
I flounder in the shallows.
I drift down with the current.
I bob up and down in the water.
I slip up to your ankle.
I thread between the water weeds.
I slide down along the trench.
I creep along the bottom.
I roll and change course.
I beat my tail a few times.
I swim from dark into light.
The undercurrent pulls my feelers straight.
Silt is drifting down to the seabed.
I rest on the bottom.
My tail sways slowly.
I am watching the surface.

lines.zh: 水从我的身体两侧流过
lines.en: Water slips past my flanks.
My cirri are curled up.
I am still as a stone.
I am listening through the water.
I turn slowly to one side.
My fins droop.
I let out a string of bubbles.
I lie on my side and drift.
I am waiting for something to pass.
My eyes have no whites.
I circle you underwater.
Your feet are too close.
I am small, but not afraid.
I rise close to the surface.
Dare you step in?
My fins stand up.
I will not yield an inch.
I am waiting for your feet.
The moment water stirs, I move.
I roll over in pain.
My body is cut open.
I thrash my tail.
Blood spreads through the water.
I slide along the sea floor.
My fins droop.
I squeeze into a rock crevice.
I am still swimming.
A corner of my fin is torn away.
I come back up.
Something stirs in the water.
I swim toward that smell.
I slide along the bottom without a sound.
Raw meat is what I want.
I circle it.
I poke my head out to sniff.
I bite it and sink deeper.
I tear at it below the surface.
This is not very fresh.
I bite down and hold.
You step on me; I squirm free.
I butt your ankle.
I am knocked onto my back.
I slide past your foot.
The impact rings the water.
The moment you touched me, I slid away.
I press to you; you pull away.
You almost pinned me.
I flick my tail and bounce off.
I steady my course again.
Another comes along the bottom.
We circle each other in the water.
Our tails touch.
We swim deeper together.
It is slightly longer than I.
We skim the bottom side by side.
It darts in front of me.
We break the surface together.
We make no sound.
It follows me a long way.
I bite what is in the water.
I toss it up with my mouth.
I wedge it into a crevice.
I swallow it and spit it out.
I push it along as I swim.
I carry it deeper.
I haul it onto the bank.
I tear off a piece.
I clamp on and will not let go.
I fling it away with a snap.
The water moved; I know.
I turn to face you.
I tense my body.
I dart toward you.
In the water you are easy prey.
I open my mouth wide.
Silt billows up behind me.
Your size does not frighten me.
I have my angle.
I strike first.
I circle your legs.
I wait for your foot in the shallows.
I come up behind you.
The water hides my sound.
I stay low and do not surface.
You turn; I change direction.
I predict where you will step.
My fins stand straight.
The ripples gave you away.
I steal a little closer.
I bite your ankle.
My tail slaps hard.
I butt your knee.
I bite and twist.
You wobble from the pull.
I burst up onto the bank.
My teeth are fine and many.
I clamp my teeth again.
I let go and retreat into water.
Water drips off all of me.

lines.zh: 水里忽然多了一道影子
lines.en: A shadow appears in the water.
I rise from under the water.
I beat my tail fin twice.
A ring of bubbles breaks the surface.
I swim along the bank.
I have found this water.
My body shines in the light.
I swim with a few of my kind.
I surface head first.
The water here is warm.
The heated water makes me flip.
I am flung out and dropped.
Even in water I struggle.

lines.zh: 滑行者离了水，扑腾两下。
lines.en: Out of the water, the slider flops twice.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面扎中我
lines.en: An arrow finds me through the water.

lines.zh: 咒光在水里烫着我的鳃
lines.en: Spellfire burns my gills.
Hunger keeps me from swimming.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我浑身一抽
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I seize up.
The water is gone; I fall.
